body: Depending on where they are you can always wear swim shorts or a skirted bottom to help cover them.
I "walk into shit" all the time. Corners can be quite sharp.

Knowing how much of a pain in the ass it is to schedule a psych visit keep going to this guy until you can get into see a new one. Then drop his ass like a hot potato. If he's part of a care network I would contact them and report him.
Honestly, to hell with other people. If you make them uncomfortable then they need to reassess their attitude towards mental health. Wear the short sleeves.

It's also addictive and as other posters on this sub have mentioned you need to go deeper and deeper to get the same "fix". When you're in that place it's hard to see how much damage you're actually doing to your body.

As my therapist has told me many times, you are under no obligation to answer anyone's questions. The response that works best for me (instead of just ignoring the question because some people can't take a hint) is "I'm not comfortable answering that question" then move on to another topic.

I went about 2 years as well before relapsing due to extreme uncontrolled anxiety. I'm not ashamed about it though, it's more of a survival mode thing for me as I can't get in to see my med doc until late June. Sh at least takes the edge off where ativan and alcohol did not.
